newsitem.title: SPAIN: Peseta debt/interbank market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Peseta debt/interbank market closing report.

text.p: Spain's debt market closed virtually unchanged on Thursday after a see-saw session as government bonds searched desperately for news about EMU, dealers said.

"It's always the same. Either we're expecting the French election or the Ecofin or the France-German summit," a Madrid-based dealer said. "But what we need is a clearer outlook on EMU (and it seems we never get that)".
Earlier, bonos fell following talk that France was ready to ask for a delay in EMU's start. The rumours were later officially denied.
Dealers said they were expecting another tight trading range on Friday, with the market focussing on the 1230 GMT release of U.S. May jobs data.
The 10-year spread over Bunds ended flat versus the open at 76 bps, despite hitting 73 bps during the afternoon.
While the peseta remained trapped around early levels versus the mark, dealers said the short end of the yield curve had also been steady.
